title: Limit on Salary Reduction for Work Permit Holder
what_it_is: Limit on Salary Reduction for Work Permit Holder

sections.label: Salary reductions for Work Permit holders
sections.summary: MOM was notified of salary reductions affecting under 2% of non-domestic Work Permit holders yearly, and is studying the issue and consulting stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In the past three years, the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) was notified of salary reductions affecting less than 2% of non-domestic Work Permit holders per year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: From that number, less than one in 10 were within one month, and about four in 10 were within one year, after the Work Permit was issued.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As explained in a reply to a Parliamentary Question raised by the Member on this topic last month, MOM is studying the issue and we will consult the relevant stakeholders to determine the best step forward for foreign workers.

sections.label: Consulting NGOs on salary issue
sections.summary: MOM is open to consulting NGOs and taking their feedback, and requires documentation when there is a dispute.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Second, could I also ask, with the upcoming consultation, whether MOM would also be consulting with non-government organisations (NGOs) that are working on this issue as well?

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Certainly, we are open to NGOs being consulted or taking their feedback.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: At this moment, we do not take every written change at the point of application.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But having said that, when there is a dispute, we will require the documentation to be provided.

sections.label: Salary reduction before Work Permit issuance
sections.summary: Any salary reduction before Work Permit issuance is an offence, so no documentation needs to be submitted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: In short, any reduction in salary before the Work Permit issuance will constitute an offence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Technically, there is no need for them to submit any documentation because reduction in salary before Work Permit issuance is not allowed.
